messages:
marta: noticed increased mTLS handshake failures in ap-south after RBAC roll last night. Logs show KMS unwrap denies.

leo: same here. errors: `KMS:AccessDenied` from keystore-proxy-runner SA. us regions OK.

tan: I deployed the RBAC tighten PR (kms-unwrap-limit). It was meant to remove legacy SAs. Might have been too aggressive.

marta: can someone pull last 7d KMS decrypt principals? need to compare.

auditbot: AuditQueryResult: principals=[svc-keystore-proxy@infra, svc-rotate-runner@ops, svc-storage@infra] from 2026-03-13..2026-03-20.

leo: quick mitigation: re-add decrypt permission to svc-keystore-proxy in affected namespaces and roll canary to ap-south.

tan: doing canary now. also adding log detail to keystore client so error includes `principal` and `key-id`.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started: namespace=infra target=ap-south patch=keystore-proxy-decrypt-restore

marta: canary healthy after 90s; unwrap denies drop. scheduling full roll.

leo: follow-ups: add CI check that fails RBAC PRs removing kms:Decrypt for principals seen in last 14 days; add a changelog entry in security playbooks; and run a one-time audit for any other SAs missing decrypt.

tan: opening PR for CI check and client error improvement.

auditbot: IncidentNote: id=2026-03-kms-rbac-01 status=resolved tags=[rbac,kms,mTLS]
